main_text.l: Nequis vero Syndi Frisiorum ad Danubium ...
consedit. Alii tamen illudunt Carolum Magnum ...
referunt, & verius: hoc ad Gediminum ab Hierosolymis
nus qui Olympiades Graecorum libri ... s-
cripsit: Pausanias qui vel cum Graecum
reliquit: Dio Pilliam Lucius Mecatus Antiquarius ... Iulius Bertius,
Dionis: Nihil ... ora ... mo credidiit ... civitate ... Regis ... Maximus Tirus ... Aurelii praeceptor Crispus Caesar, qui cum ... Diogenes ...
Tandem ... temporis martyrio coronati ... Droxanus Iuvenis
Geographica reliquit ... Hadrianus ... Iudaei ... Rhetor, qui ... Tutorem ...
in Africa le Ipsum a cauda medium contentum.

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and show-through from the reverse side is heavy; many words in the left margin and body lines are illegible and have been transcribed approximately, with uncertain readings not individually marked. Lines in the lower half are largely unreadable.
